title: Reuters: US ocean container imports set new record for September, Descartes says
summary: Reuters highlights the latest Descartes Global Shipping Report, which found that U.S. ocean container imports reached a new record for September. The findings underscore the continued strength of U.S. import activity despite ongoing tariff and geopolitical volatility, reinforcing the importance of supply chain visibility, risk management and informed planning as businesses navigate shifting global trade conditions.
body_markdown:
Reuters highlights the latest Descartes Global Shipping Report, which found that U.S. ocean container imports reached a new record for September. The findings underscore the continued strength of U.S. import activity despite ongoing tariff and geopolitical volatility, reinforcing the importance of supply chain visibility, risk management and informed planning as businesses navigate shifting global trade conditions.


[Read more on reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-ocean-container-imports-set-new-record-september-descartes-says-2026-10-08/)
